stripe_invoice_id.title: Stripe invoice ID
stripe_invoice_id.description: ID of the paid invoice (in_...). Used to build the Metronome uniqueness key.

stripe_subscription_id.title: Stripe subscription ID
stripe_subscription_id.description: ID of the subscription that generated the invoice (sub_...).

credit_amount.title: Credit amount
credit_amount.description: Subscription metadata: metronome_credit_amount. Positive integer in the credit type's units (USD credit types are in cents).

credit_priority.title: Credit priority
credit_priority.description: Subscription metadata: metronome_credit_priority. Non-negative integer. Defaults to 100.

credit_access_type.title: Credit access type
credit_access_type.description: Subscription metadata: metronome_credit_access_type. SPEND or QUANTITY. Defaults to SPEND.

starting_at.title: Credit starts at
starting_at.description: Start of the paid service period. Unix seconds or RFC 3339.

ending_before.title: Credit ends before
ending_before.description: End of the paid service period (exclusive). Unix seconds or RFC 3339.

stripe_livemode.title: Invoice livemode
stripe_livemode.description: Invoice livemode. Must be false for this POC.

invoice_amount_paid.title: Invoice amount paid
invoice_amount_paid.description: Invoice amount_paid in the smallest currency unit. Must be greater than 0.

invoice_currency.title: Invoice currency
invoice_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code of the invoice.

invoice_paid_out_of_band.title: Invoice paid out of band
invoice_paid_out_of_band.description: true or false. Must be false for a credit to be created.
